title: FakeTalismans
description: Custom Talismans. This plugin adds the ability to create and customize talismans on servers.
body:
### **Commands**

- /faketalismans help — Show help message.
- /faketalismans reload — Reload configuration, recipes, and talismans.
- /faketalismans give <player> <id> — Give a talisman to a player.
- /faketalismans talismans [player] — Open the talismans GUI.
- /faketalismans test — Add all registered talismans to your inventory (OP only).

Available aliases:

- /ftalismans

### **  Permissions**

- faketalismans.admin — Admin commands (give, reload, test, open GUI for others).
- faketalismans.talismans — Open the talismans GUI for yourself.
- faketalismans.staff — Access to staff notifications.

### **Compatibility**

- **Server software**: Paper / Purpur / Spigot 1.20+
- **Java**: Java 17+
- **Configuration format**: YAML (config.yml & talismans.yml)
- **Required dependencies**: None

### **Features**

**Create Custom Talismans**: Design unique RPG items with custom materials, skins, and properties.
**Attribute Modifiers**: Passive stat boosts applied when equipping a talisman. Supports:

- Health Boost (HEALTH_BOOST)
- Movement Speed (MOVEMENT_SPEED)
- Attack Damage (ATTACK_DAMAGE)
- Knockback Resistance (KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE)
- Armor (ARMOR)
- Armor Toughness (ARMOR_TOUGHNESS)
- Attack Speed (ATTACK_SPEED)
- Luck (LUCK)

**Equipment Slots**: Configure attribute boosts to activate only in specific slots:
- mainhand / main_hand
- offhand / off_hand
- head
- chest
- legs
- feet

1. **Hex Colors & Gradients**: Complete support for modern color systems in display names and lore.
1. **Custom Model Data**: Easily bind custom 3D models from your resource pack.
1. **Player Head Textures**: Use player skin URLs, base64 values, or head UUIDs.
1. **Item Properties**: Configure custom enchantments, glow effect, unbreakable state, and item flags.
1. **Safe live reloads**: Reload files with /faketalismans reload dynamically.
1. **Corrupted Talisman Removal**: Automatically removes items from players if the talisman is deleted from the configuration (Remove-talismans option).
